html: † חֲצַרְמָ֫וֶת n.pr.m. (Arabic حَضْرَمَوْت, Sab. חצֿרמות, חצֿרמת, Os ZMG 1865, 239 ff. DHM ZMG 1883, 18. 412)—a ‘son’ of יָקְטָן, 5th in order from Shem (שֵׁם, 1. אַרְפַּכְשַׁד; 2. שֶׁלַח; 3. עֵבֶר; 4. יָקְטָן; 5. ח׳) Gn 10:26 = 1 Ch 1:20, 𝔊 Ασαρ(α)μωθ; = n.pr.terr. a district in southern Arabia, where dwelt the Χατραμωτῖται (Strabo xvi. 4. 2); mod. Ḥaḍramaut (or Ḥaḍramût, see Maltzan ZMG 1871, 493 MordtZMG 1876, 323, van d. Bergp. 9, v. infr.) is same land, but not quite co-extensive; v. Di Gn 10:26, Ritter Erdkunde xii (Arabien i) 609 ff., de GoejeḤadhr. 1886, van den BergḤadhramout, 1886, GlaserSkizze ii. 20, 423 ff. etc.; on its precise limits see especially Ritter 611 ff., de Goejel.c. van d. Berg ch. 1.
